headline: Big Balder Brand: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Big Balder Brand is projected #2 of 16 with a 709.90 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Trey McBride, Rashee Rice, and A.J. Brown. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core. On the Power Rankings webpage's D-AVI ladder, the franchise ranks #1 of 16 with a 331.0 team D-AVI score.

projected_power.method: Sum of the eight verified projected starters' C-AVI values from all 16 AVI-Core team files

dynasty_power.method: Exact rank and team D-AVI score from the live Autobots HQ Power Rankings webpage ladder

latest_trade.summary: On July 24, Big Balder Brand traded with DMV Fantasy and acquired Cam Little, Saquon Barkley while sending Breece Hall. Cam Little is now on the current roster; Saquon Barkley is now the current RB starter at 92.1 C-AVI and 92.7 D-AVI.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the FLEX slot above Chris Godwin's 62.2 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 75.3 C-AVI would directly attack the 13.10-point projected gap to Conquistadors.
Use draft capital as a targeted sweetener for a verified starting-lineup upgrade, not for additional bench depth.

latest_trade.summary: On October 29, Mile High Royal Lions traded with TacticsNoob and acquired Marvin Harrison while sending Rachaad White, 2026 Round 2 (Conquistadors), 2027 Round 1 (Big Balder Brand). Marvin Harrison is now the current FLEX starter at 72.6 C-AVI and 87.4 D-AVI; The deal sent out 2 draft assets, reducing future flexibility.
